# Kenney Car Kit Assets

Selected GLB models from Kenney Car Kit 3.1 for the traffic-jam visual.

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
- Creator: Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)
- Original archive kept locally at `_asset_sources/kenney_car-kit.zip` and not committed.
- License text: `LICENSE.txt`

The curated `models/` subset includes the 11 GLB vehicle models referenced by
`assets/vehicle-proxies.json`. Unused models from the downloaded kit were
removed before commit to keep the repository footprint small.
